Subject: CardioWorks MAP — Final stretch: Go‑Live checklist & cutover window

Hi Elena / Mark —

Quick weekly checkpoint as we enter the final stretch for the Apr 20 go‑live. Attaching the latest MAP and runbook (see attachments). Key items for this week: 

- Confirm cutover window: target 2027‑04‑20 02:00–03:30 UTC (initial ask). Please confirm any blackout windows on your side.
- Rehearsal: plan a full runbook rehearsal on 2027‑04‑15 (2h). Calendar invite will follow once we lock owners.
- Owners & SLAs: we need a single owner for DB freeze, network routing, and DocuSign signing path.
- Fallbacks: propose blue/green with KV migration as primary fallback; we need to validate rollback and data-safety checks in the rehearsal.

Immediate asks: please reply by EOD Fri with:
  * confirmation/constraints on cutover window (exact UTC range)
  * owner for DB cutover and who will run the rollback if needed
  * any procurement/sign-off blockers for DocuSign envelope

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, runbook_v3.pdf

Thanks —
Priyom
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: CardioWorks MAP — Final stretch: Go‑Live checklist & cutover window

Thanks, Priyom. Helpful summary. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- Procurement: we need final DocuSign envelope and a copy of the DATA processing addendum before finance signs off. I've attached a short procurement checklist (cardioworks_procurement.pdf).
- SOC 2: our security team flagged a required confirmation on KMS/HSM integration for keying production logs. Can you confirm whether Redwood will use customer-managed KMS for this deployment? If not, we need the SOC evidence for your managed key setup.
- Cutover window: we have nightly batch jobs that finish ~23:30 PDT; the team requests a start no earlier than 01:00 UTC (which is 18:00 PDT). Can you confirm the proposed 02:00–03:30 UTC still works?

If the KMS answer is quick we can proceed; otherwise procurement will put a hold.

On the rehearsal: confirm whether you want a dry run (no DNS flip) on 15th and a full rehearsal with DNS & traffic cutover on 18th. We prefer the two-step approach.

—Elena
Product Ops, CardioWorks
elena@cardioworks.com

Subject: Re: CardioWorks MAP — Final stretch: Go‑Live checklist & cutover window

Good questions — here's an owners snapshot and proposed rehearsal cadence. I'll own the cutover run coordination and be the escalation contact on D‑Day.

Owners & commitments (short):
- DB freeze & migration validation: Mina Haddad (DB lead) — will publish migration checklist by 2027‑04‑10
- Network & DNS flip: Ben Carter (NetEng) — responsible for routing tests and scripted DNS rollback
- KV / cache sync & warmup: Aditya Rao — will run incremental sync tool during rehearsal
- Procurement / DocuSign follow-up: Priyom Das — will send final envelope link and DPA

Rehearsal plan:
- 2027‑04‑15 18:00–20:00 UTC — dry run (runbook steps, coordination, no DNS flip)
- 2027‑04‑18 02:00–04:00 UTC — full rehearsal including DNS flip, traffic validation, and rollback test (short window)

DocuSign: I've prepared the envelope and queued it with our legal review. Priyom — I pasted the envelope link below; Priyom / Procurement, please confirm the DPA is attached so CardioWorks procurement can sign.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/48231

On the cutover window: 02:00–03:30 UTC is acceptable from our side, but Mina flagged that DB churn from your nightly jobs might push the safe start later. Mina — can you confirm earliest safe start?

Attachments referenced: runbook_v3.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@cardioworks.com>, Mark Sullivan <mark.sullivan@cardioworks.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CardioWorks MAP — Final stretch: Go‑Live checklist & cutover window

Short update — DB constraints and fallback approach.

- DB constraint: we cannot start the migration earlier than 01:00 UTC on 2027‑04‑20 because of CardioWorks batch jobs; the safe window per infra is 01:00–04:00 UTC. That overlaps the proposed window, but means we should treat the 01:00 UTC as the earliest possible start.
- Fallback: recommend blue/green with incremental KV migration (no full rollbacks). Plan: run traffic cutover to green, validate 15m of traffic, then switch incrementally. If we must rollback, script will revert traffic and replay from last consistent KV snapshot (we must test snapshot restore in rehearsal).
- Action items I will own before 2027‑04‑15: publish DB migration checklist, run snapshot/restore test (result to be posted to Drive), and confirm expected downtime for read replicas.

Ben — please update rehearsal invites to 2027‑04‑15 18:00 UTC and 2027‑04‑18 02:00 UTC; Priyom — please attach final DPA with the DocuSign envelope so procurement can move.

Onward — Mina
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
